comparison.objective: Align a coupled shaft and prove low runout; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper to produce repeatable safe stops.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests coaxial alignment and runout correction; candidate tests hex-key insertion, bimanual counterholding, collar adjustment, locking torque, and iterative response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires acceptable shaft runout; candidate requires two compliant dynamic stops with bounded energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and setting drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve commissioning and measurement, but shaft geometric alignment/runout is a different tested ability from changing damping and validating impact response. The record has no spec versions and omits the runout threshold and exact coupling procedure.
